summary: Keep failed population refreshes asleep until a store commit or known classification deadline

replay.detail: No replay or backfill is required.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or claim changes.

rules.detail: Population and attention source authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Failed population folds or blocking tasks retain diagnostics and the last complete snapshot without advancing last-success or scheduling an unconditional retry timer. A store commit or an unconsumed future classification deadline from the last successful fold admits the next attempt after the existing minimum rest. Expired deadlines are consumed on failure.

manual.detail: Existing deployment configuration and freshness alerts remain applicable.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback; durable state is unchanged.
